_about: The chats already in the sidebar the first time the prototype is opened in a browser, so the Chats list and the Recent chat link are not empty in a demo. Each is just its first prompt: the reply is worked out live, exactly as if it had been typed. hoursAgo sets how recent it looks; the smallest is the Recent chat. Once someone has chatted, their own chats are kept instead and these are not added again.

chats.prompt: Prep an account brief for Coca-Cola
